content: Yes — at 29 in Zurich the tax deduction alone typically makes it worth it, and you have decades of compounding ahead. Just don't put in money you might need before retirement, and pick an invested 3a over a plain savings account if you can.

Caveats: only if they have an emergency fund first, and ideally invest rather than leave it in a low-interest account. But keep to two sentences, direct.
